Market today: Oil prices are jumping, which could put pressure on the broader market and especially on tech if it leads to inflation fears. Your concentrated tech/chip book is sensitive to this.

Your holdings: SOXL (-32.61%) and SPAL (-33.88%) are the clear SELL/TRIM candidates given their leveraged nature and current losses. They are bleeding on margin.

Watch: Keep an eye on Nvidia's software platform release, as it could be a positive catalyst for the chip sector.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and watching for any signs of broader market weakness.
plays: Trim SOXL and SPAL: These leveraged ETFs are deep in the red and decaying. Cut losses here to preserve capital.
Consider AMD: Scanner shows ACCUMULATE with entry 629.75-629.04, stop 625.9. Strong daily/4H/1H uptrend.
Consider TSM: Scanner shows ACCUMULATE with entry 450.16-449.71, stop 448.48. Similar strong uptrend.
